risks.risk: The engine may be a used part or a rebuilt unit rather than a genuine original Ford part.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine identification plate (usually on the engine block or a stamped plate).
risks.if_unproven: as a used or rebuilt engine

risks.risk: The engine may be missing the necessary accessories like the alternator or air intake manifold.
risks.proof: A photo showing all components included in the sale.
risks.if_unproven: as an engine without the alternator and air intake

risks.risk: The engine may be non-functional or have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video of the engine running or a compression test result.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine identification plate showing the engine code.
Photo of the engine with the alternator and air intake manifold.
Video of the engine running or a compression test result.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
